purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer-as-aircraft-or-engine-OEM, listed airline operator or aircraft lessor program configuration, order and production serial, factory acceptance, delivery and registration, airworthiness certification and directives, service bulletins, grounding and return to service, airframe-engine-component life limits, maintenance checks, shop visits, overhaul and release before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: generic manufacturing, supply-chain, capex, inventory, logistics, lease and operating-scale records
generic passenger transport, incident, support, automotive and shipping-fleet records
aggregate order backlog, deliveries, fleet size, utilization, load factor, dispatch reliability, delay, maintenance and cost KPIs

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction, supersession, type-certification, program-configuration, production-serial, factory-acceptance, delivery, registration, airworthiness-certificate, directive, service-bulletin, inspection, compliance, grounding, return-to-service, maintenance-check, shop-visit, removal, installation, overhaul and release timestamps mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable listed-parent, OEM, operator, lessor, program, aircraft type and variant, engine and APU type, privacy-safe airframe serial or tail, component identity and maintenance-program identities without present-day fleet, registration, airworthiness or maintenance-status projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including ordered, cancelled, allocated, produced, accepted, delivered, registered, stored, leased, returned and retired aircraft; affected, inspected, compliant, overdue, grounded and returned-to-service aircraft; and installed, removed, life-limited, due, overhauled, rejected and released components

explicit missing, delayed, unavailable, cancelled, held, stored, grounded, inspected, noncompliant, deferred, removed, scrapped, overhauled, released and genuine-zero semantics plus program, serial, registration, airworthiness and component-life conservation without filling uncovered aircraft, operators, components or periods with zero

no passenger or crew identity, private owner identity, precise nonpublic flight trace, security-sensitive aircraft-system detail, maintenance manuals, export-controlled design data, private lease terms, commercial secrets or trade secrets

scientific_interpretation: A linked aircraft program and production-serial history together with registration, airworthiness, grounding and life-limited maintenance disposition is economically distinct from generic passenger operations, manufacturing, leases, incidents, automotive, shipping, logistics and KPI records, but distinction alone does not admit a factor. The absent complete lawful point-in-time aerospace operating source is the binding gate.
